wsUpgrade.label: Proactive WebSocket Upstream Upgrade
wsUpgrade.description: When enabled, always try WS upstream regardless of client protocol; when disabled, follow client protocol

sseHeartbeat.label: SSE Heartbeat Interval (seconds)
sseHeartbeat.description: Set to 0 to disable heartbeat; 30-60 seconds is recommended behind Cloudflare.
sseHeartbeat.compatibility: Some clients may mishandle SSE comments, so disable it if compatibility issues occur.

ssePreStreamHeartbeat.label: SSE Pre-stream Heartbeat Delay (seconds)
ssePreStreamHeartbeat.description: Set to 0 to disable pre-stream heartbeats. When enabled, an SSE comment is sent only if the upstream stream is still not established after this delay.
ssePreStreamHeartbeat.risk: This may reduce Cloudflare 524 risk but can affect retry behavior in some clients.

groupHealth.label: Group Health Checks
groupHealth.description: When enabled, show the home health summary, group-card health status, and allow manual health checks.

responseValidator.name: Response Validator / Soft Error Detection
responseValidator.desc: Detects soft failures such as HTTP 200 with empty choices/output/content, HTML login pages, Cloudflare pages, and upstream error JSON.
responseValidator.ui: Log detail and attempt timeline show failure reasons. Model test results also show failure_reason directly.
responseValidator.gap: Validator rules are safe defaults and intentionally not user-toggleable to avoid returning bad upstream responses.

failoverRetry.name: Failover / Retry Chain
failoverRetry.desc: Bad candidates can fail over to later candidates. Same-channel retry and candidate failover are recorded as attempts.
failoverRetry.ui: Group cards show runtime strategy. Log detail shows the full attempt chain, HTTP status, latency, and retryable state.
failoverRetry.gap: Same-channel retry details can be made more compact and visual later.

streamGate.name: Stream First Valid Chunk Gate
streamGate.desc: Stream requests buffer before the first valid output, allowing empty streams, DONE-only streams, and invalid SSE to fail over.
streamGate.ui: Settings expose global timeout, max buffer, DONE-only, and invalid SSE behavior. Group cards show first valid output timeout.
streamGate.gap: Still needs NAS / Docker fake-upstream validation that bad streams are not written to clients before failover.

traceAttempts.name: Trace / Attempt Logs
traceAttempts.desc: A client request can contain multiple upstream attempts with channel, model, status, error, TTFB, duration, usage, and cost.
traceAttempts.ui: Available from the standalone traces workbench, log detail, model-test log jump, and the home observability dashboard.
traceAttempts.gap: Backed by separate request_traces / request_attempts tables, page/detail export, trace comparison, and server-side audit aggregation.

healthCooldown.name: Health Score / Cooldown / Smart Routing
healthCooldown.desc: Uses real feedback, success rate, empty response rate, latency, and cooldown state to sort or skip candidates.
healthCooldown.ui: Settings expose health weights and cooldown policy. Group routing preview shows health score, cooldown, and decisions.
healthCooldown.gap: Key / channel / base_url / site / account cooldown scopes are implemented. Hard concurrency queueing is now exposed as a separate capability.

channelModelHealth.name: Channel-Model Health Workbench
channelModelHealth.desc: Aggregates real relay, model test, and slow probe feedback by channel_id + model_name with health score, success rate, latency, throughput, cost, load, cooldown, and quota.
channelModelHealth.ui: The Channels > Model Health tab provides filters, realtime refresh, a virtualized table, and managed site/account context.
channelModelHealth.gap: Still needs NAS / Docker validation with real health samples.

selectionTracker.name: Burst Selection Spreading / Selection Tracker
selectionTracker.desc: When health scheduling is enabled, in-flight channel+model selections are tracked so equal-health bursts do not all land on one channel.
selectionTracker.ui: Group routing preview shows in-flight selections and effective score. Runtime routing prefers the lower-load peer among equal candidates.
selectionTracker.gap: This is in-memory runtime spreading. Hard concurrency queueing is now exposed as separate configuration.

channelConcurrency.name: Channel + Model Hard Concurrency Queue
channelConcurrency.desc: Limits real in-flight requests by channel_id + model_name. Overflow waits briefly in-process, then fails over to later candidates on timeout.
channelConcurrency.ui: Settings expose enablement, local / database mode, per-channel-model max in-flight, queue timeout, and lease TTL. Channel model health shows current hard-concurrency load.
channelConcurrency.gap: Off by default and local by default. Database mode now provides the shared lease foundation; real multi-replica load testing is still needed.

distributedQueue.name: Distributed Shared Queue / Limit
distributedQueue.desc: Adds an optional database lease backend for multi-replica deployments, sharing channel + model in-flight slots across processes with TTL cleanup.
distributedQueue.ui: Settings can select local / database mode and lease TTL. Channel Model Health and Group Routing Preview show the current queue mode and load.
distributedQueue.gap: The database lease foundation, TTL cleanup, and backend tests are in place. Finer queue wait logs, crash-cleanup stress tests, and NAS / Docker multi-replica acceptance are still pending.

slowProbe.name: Slow Active Probe
slowProbe.desc: Off by default. Low-frequency probes supplement unknown, degraded, or cooldown-expired candidates without stressing upstreams.
slowProbe.ui: Settings expose enablement, stream probe, site interval, site-model interval, concurrency, daily budget, prompt, max tokens, temperature, and jitter.
slowProbe.gap: Rate-limit / budget / backoff state is still in memory and resets on restart. NAS / Docker validation is still needed.

costUsage.name: Usage / Cost Accounting
costUsage.desc: Records final success cost, failed attempt estimated cost, total failover-chain cost, cache tokens, and service tier.
costUsage.ui: Home observability, log list, and log detail attempt rows show tokens, cache, cost, and cost source.
costUsage.gap: For very large logs, this may later need dedicated stats tables or incremental caches.

modelTest.name: Real Request Model Test
modelTest.desc: User-triggered short-prompt testing with channel/model modes, concurrency, stream mode, TTFB, duration, tokens, cost, and response summary.
modelTest.ui: The Model Test page provides the operation panel, result table, and log-detail jump.
modelTest.gap: Needs NAS / Docker validation with many real models for scrolling, filtering, selection, and log jump behavior.

groupAutoGenerate.name: One-click Model Group Generation
groupAutoGenerate.desc: Creates or fills groups from discovered model names, grouping identical model names together.
groupAutoGenerate.ui: The Groups page provides bulk generation, selected generation, preview, filters, and result summaries.
groupAutoGenerate.gap: Still recommended to validate once with synced site models and once with regular channels.

modelAssociation.name: Model Association / Alias Folding
modelAssociation.desc: Keeps the Octopus group model while folding common upstream aliases such as provider/model and models/... into the same public model group.
modelAssociation.ui: Both the group bulk-generation dialog and the settings-page defaults card can configure advanced association rules, persisted defaults, manual alias mapping, match scores, and strategy explanations directly in preview.
modelAssociation.gap: Still does not introduce AxonHub Provider / GlobalModel / full ModelAssociation conditions. Tag-assisted folding and richer cross-provider conditions remain future work.

protocolTransform.name: Protocol Transform Compatibility
protocolTransform.desc: Preserves transformer and passthrough support for OpenAI Chat / Responses / Anthropic / Gemini / Codex.
protocolTransform.ui: Channel type, model-test protocol, and log attempt protocol path are visible.
protocolTransform.gap: No standalone transformer inspector yet. Codex / Gemini still appear through existing entries and outbound channel types.

liveDebug.name: Live Debug / Active Requests
liveDebug.desc: ccLoad has stronger active request and debug snapshot views for in-flight troubleshooting.
liveDebug.ui: The Logs page now shows active request snapshots with model, phase, candidate channel, key ID, site/account, attempt count, first-token, written state, and redacted request / response previews.
liveDebug.gap: Current snapshots are in memory. Debug event streaming and redacted payload previews are connected, structured traces are covered by the standalone workbench, and deeper on-demand raw debugging can still be added later.

safeDiagnosticsExport.name: Safe Export / Redacted Diagnostics
safeDiagnosticsExport.desc: Structured exports use whitelisted fields for logs, log detail, active debug, traces, channel model health, group routing preview, and model test results.
safeDiagnosticsExport.ui: Logs, log detail, active debug, traces, channel model health, group routing preview, and model test all expose export actions with safety notes or toast feedback.
safeDiagnosticsExport.gap: Full raw request / response debugging still needs a confirmed safety policy. Current exports do not include full bodies or authentication data.

quotaStatus.name: Quota / Capacity Status Resolver
quotaStatus.desc: Explains candidate capacity from managed account balance, disabled site-models, key status codes, and health cooldown reasons with structured capacity status, scope, source, observation time, and expiry.
quotaStatus.ui: Group routing preview and Channel Model Health show quota status, capacity status, source / scope, observation time, and cooldown expiry; real relay already enforces managed account disabled, known zero balance, and disabled site-model skips.
quotaStatus.gap: Keeps the Octopus site/account/channel structure and does not import AxonHub Provider / GlobalModel quota objects. Distributed quota storage remains future work.

health.subtitle: Off by default. Uses real request feedback to influence candidate ordering.

window.label: Stats Window (minutes)
window.hint: Only request feedback inside this window is counted.

sample.label: Min Confident Samples

failureWeight.label: Failure Penalty Weight

emptyWeight.label: Empty Response Penalty
emptyWeight.hint: Higher values push empty choices/content candidates lower.

latencyWeight.label: Latency Penalty Weight
latencyWeight.hint: Higher values push slow candidates lower.

cooldown.title: Cooldown Policy

channelConcurrency.title: Channel Model Hard Concurrency
channelConcurrency.subtitle: Off by default. Limits real in-flight requests by channel + model; queue timeout allows later candidates to be tried.

mode.label: Queue Mode
mode.hint: local limits only this process; database uses database leases to share slots across replicas.

max.label: Max In-flight Requests
max.hint: Concurrent upstream requests allowed for each channel + model.

queue.label: Queue Wait (ms)
queue.hint: Local wait time after the limit is reached. 0 switches to the next candidate immediately.

lease.label: Lease TTL (ms)
lease.hint: Slot lease time in database mode. Active requests renew it automatically; abnormal exits release after expiry.

probe.title: Slow Active Probe
probe.subtitle: Off by default. Only probes unknown, degraded, or cooldown-expired candidates.

siteInterval.label: Site Interval (minutes)
siteInterval.hint: Minimum interval between active probes for the same site.

modelInterval.label: Site Model Interval (hours)
modelInterval.hint: Minimum interval between active probes for the same site and model.

dailyBudget.label: Daily Site Budget
dailyBudget.hint: Maximum active probe requests per site per day.

prompt.label: Probe Prompt
prompt.hint: Short prompt used for non-stream probes.

maxTokens.label: Max Output Tokens
maxTokens.hint: Maximum output tokens for probe requests.

jitter.label: Jitter Ratio
jitter.hint: Value from 0 to 1, used to spread probe timing.

stream.label: Use Stream Probe
stream.hint: When enabled, slow probes send stream=true and judge valid replies from SSE content. Off by default to preserve the existing probe traffic shape.

stream.title: Stream First Valid Output Gate
stream.subtitle: Buffers stream bytes before the first visible output and retries another candidate on bad streams.

timeout.label: Global Timeout (seconds)
timeout.hint: Used when a group has no override. 0 means no limit.

buffer.label: Max Buffer Bytes
buffer.hint: Maximum SSE bytes buffered before the first valid output; exceeding it is a retryable failure.

emptyDone.label: Fail On DONE Only
emptyDone.hint: When enabled, an upstream that only returns [DONE] before valid content will fail over.

invalidSSE.label: Fail On Invalid SSE
invalidSSE.hint: When enabled, parse errors before the first valid output will fail over.
